hana (sec-eng): DAST picked up what looks like an auth bypass on /sso/return in staging. reproduction says forged state allowed session creation.

omar (backend): huh. we granted a temporary keystore read role to the scan-runner yesterday for fixtures. could be a scope leak.

hana (sec-eng): can you confirm exact binding? need principal + role and timestamp.

omar (backend): `serviceAccount:scan-runner@infra` -> `roles/keystore.viewer` at 2024-06-21T10:58. intended for a single job.

sela (infra): revoke done at 11:05 and kicked a KMS test key rotation job rot-2024-5959. also increased keystore IAM audit retention to 90d.

hana (sec-eng): run a quick canary from an external IP and paste response (should be 401/redirect, not 200).

omar (backend): canary result 11:12: `auth callback rejected -> 401`. looks mitigated. i'll run full regression and add test coverage to reject unknown state tokens.

hana (sec-eng): cool. follow-ups: 1) require expiry on any RBAC PRs 2) scanner runbook: use orchestrator for ephemeral grants 3) attach DAST repro to INC-2024-809 and keep evidence.

ir-bot: created ticket INC-2024-809, severity=P2, attached DAST findings and SetIamPolicy audit entries.
